_doc: gr2_lint profiles of the Koreans add-on's own building models (AoP scripts/havok/gr2_lint.py --profiles tools/gr2_lint/profiles.json --profile <name> art/buildings/<folder>/). It extends AoP's profile file: the owner's texture classes and the DLL tool route come from there and are never redefined here. Relative paths resolve from this repository.

tools._owner_messages_doc: the owner's verbatim answers this add-on's profiles cite (confirmed_by, waivers)

korean_house_a._doc: Korean House A (Colonial on), texture-r14 source; donor graph: vanilla japan_shrine_age2_01(_damaged). Intact + damaged + HKT + materials + animfile. r14c: faces written with the engine winding (the export frame is a mirror; r14b shipped inside out - black roofs, dark walls). r14d: progressive destruction - stage bodies carry 14-20 % of the surface (vanilla 12-18 %; r14c 2.7-6.6 %).

texture_budget._doc: owner 2026-10-09 (tools/gr2_lint/owner_authorization.json): House A/B/C = large - the WALLS 2048 + ROOFS 2048 pages, one set for all three variants and every stage; the shared r65 atlas and the TC pottery page are pinned shared dependencies, not counted

authorization.owner_quote: - Owned textures across **all three together**: one WALLS 2048² set and one ROOFS 2048² set. Reuse the exact Korean shared matc r65 1024² and existing TC pottery page.
